Frustrating User Experience. Do NOT download if you’re expecting to create Star Wars AI photos. The ad is a blatant lie!

I wouldn’t say the images produced are entirely horrible, but the fact is I downloaded this app and paid $7 solely because the ad promised Star Wars-themed AI photos. There is no Star Wars pack. It was a complete lie. I should have known better. 😔

On top of being misled and wasting money, I tried uploading a handful of photos, and the results were extremely rough and distorted. Initially, I thought maybe my photos weren’t good enough, so I planned to re-upload higher-quality images to improve my results but guess what? You can’t do that here.

This is such a fundamental flaw that it boggles my mind. It’s clear the developers didn’t do any qualitative user testing, nor do they have proper user experience designers on their team. (I work in UX, so I can confidently say this is unacceptable.)

You cannot remove or re-upload photos once they’re submitted. This lack of basic functionality is a huge red flag and should never have made it past development into a paid product. Honestly, this app feels like a beta release being sold at full price.

Even if this core flaw didn’t exist, the processing times are outrageous 1 to 4 hours in my experience and the final results just aren’t worth the wait.

The bottom line: I spent $7 because of a lie in their advertising, expecting to create Star Wars AI photos. Instead, I got horrible depictions of my face slapped onto a random model in front of an imitation of Niagara Falls. Don’t waste your money.
